Bolivia arrests political adviser to Latin American right-wingers. Arrest comes after attack on activist Nadia Beller, who says she was targeted for her opposition to corruption.

DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak ‘global emergency’ as infections pass 5,000: WHO. Officials warn they are continuing to identify new chains of transmission that need to be broken to stop the spread.
